games.description: A three-session archive of Sark's 1995 Western-horror run: a brief first look after finishing Alone in the Dark 2, followed by a fresh Slaughter Gulch playthrough that continues through Carnby's bizarre resurrection, the radioactive underground complex, Emily Hartwood's rescue, and the final showdown with Jed Stone.
games.title: Alone in the Dark 3

games.description: A solo Chinese FMV horror game about a real-estate shoot in a haunted villa. Sark chooses occult items and hiding places, follows the ghost records, reaches an ending, and tests alternate choices.
games.title: Back

games.description: Three social-deduction sessions with changing groups of pals. The crew learns station tasks, adjusts the round settings and repeatedly undermines its own work with accusations, improvised weapons, sabotage and betrayals.
